name: Kara Ferguson
bio: Clinical Assistant Professor of Physical Therapy at Clarkson and a board-certified orthopedic specialist. Before Clarkson she worked in Nashville, Tennessee as a clinician, clinic director, and clinical instructor in outpatient orthopedics after completing an orthopedic residency through Upstream Rehabilitation in 2020; at Clarkson she teaches orthopedics, anatomy, and basic clinical skills.
